entries.title: Kartika brings a chill at night
entries.explanation: The echo between କାର୍ତ୍ତିକି and ରାତିକି makes a seasonal observation easy to remember. The line draws attention to night rather than declaring that the whole day has turned cold. In conversation it can accompany noticing a change in the air. This is a calendar-linked saying, not a forecast for every place or year.
entries.meaning_odia: କାର୍ତ୍ତିକି ସହ ରାତିକିର ମିଳ ଋତୁର କଥାକୁ ମନରେ ରଖିଦିଏ। ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଦିନସାରା ଶୀତର କଥା ନକହି ରାତିର ଥଣ୍ଡାକୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କରେ। ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ପରେ ପବନ ବଦଳିଥିବା ଅନୁଭବ କଲେ ଏହି କଥା ମନେ ପଡ଼ିପାରେ। ସବୁ ଜାଗାରେ ସବୁ ବର୍ଷ ଏକା ପାଗ ହେବ ବୋଲି ଏହାକୁ ଧରିବା ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: A rhyme links Kartika with the chill felt at night.
entries.odia_summary: କାର୍ତ୍ତିକ ଓ ରାତିର ଶୀତକୁ ଶବ୍ଦର ମିଳ ମନେ ରଖାଏ।
entries.usage_example: While sitting outside after sunset in Kartika, someone reaches for a shawl and repeats the line. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Source identifies Kartiki with Kartika and labels the line Dhaga; it supplies no climate dataset or regional distribution. Distinct from existing Magha sayings.

entries.title: Breaking rather than bending
entries.literal_meaning: The kaunria stick will break; it will not bend.
entries.explanation: The image makes refusal to yield stark: breaking becomes possible before bending does. Applied to a person, it can sound like admiration for resolve or criticism of costly stubbornness. The words alone do not settle which tone the speaker intends. The object gives that tension a shape without turning every refusal into a virtue.
entries.meaning_odia: କାଠି ନଇଁବା ବଦଳରେ ଭାଙ୍ଗିଯିବ—ଛବିଟି ନଛାଡ଼ିବା ମନୋଭାବକୁ ତୀବ୍ର କରେ। କାହାର ଦୃଢ଼ତା ଦେଖି ପ୍ରଶଂସାରେ ଏହା କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ, ପୁଣି କ୍ଷତି ହେଲେ ବି ଜିଦ୍ ନଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ ଟାହି କରି ବି। ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱର ଓ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରୁ ଫରକଟି ବୁଝାଯାଏ। ସବୁବେଳେ ନଇଁବା ଖରାପ କିମ୍ବା ନଇଁନଥିବା ଭଲ ବୋଲି ଏହା କହେ ନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: An unbending stick pictures resolve that may become costly stubbornness.
entries.odia_summary: ନଇଁନଥିବା କାଠିର ଛବିରେ ଦୃଢ଼ତା ଓ କ୍ଷତିକାରକ ଜିଦ୍ ଦୁହିଁ ପଢ଼ାଯାଇପାରେ।
entries.usage_example: A collaborator refuses even a small scheduling change until a shared project falls through; a disappointed friend repeats the saying. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Source gives a fibre-stripped plant-stem sense, not an experimentally verified botanical rule. Keep kaunria name without fixing an independently verified species. Dual social readings are editorial.

entries.title: How would the back know the belly’s pain?
entries.literal_meaning: How would the back know the belly’s pain?
entries.explanation: Even two parts of the same body do not occupy the same place. The question gives private suffering a simple image: being near someone is not the same as feeling what they feel. It can ask a listener to be less certain about another person’s troubles. That reading need not mean that understanding or help is impossible.
entries.meaning_odia: ଏକା ଦେହର ପେଟ ଓ ପିଠି ବି ଏକା ଜାଗାରେ ନାହାନ୍ତି। ଏହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ନିଜର କଷ୍ଟକୁ ଅନ୍ୟେ ସହଜରେ ବୁଝିନପାରିବାର ଭାବ ଅଛି। ପାଖରେ ରହିଲେ ବି ଅନ୍ୟ ମଣିଷର ଅନୁଭବକୁ ନିଜର ବୋଲି ଧରିନେବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ। ତଥାପି ଶୁଣିବା, ବୁଝିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବା ବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ଅସମ୍ଭବ ବୋଲି କଥାଟିକୁ ପଢ଼ିବା ଦରକାର ନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Closeness does not give automatic knowledge of someone else’s suffering.
entries.odia_summary: ପାଖରେ ଥିଲେ ବି ଅନ୍ୟର କଷ୍ଟ ଆପେ ଆପେ ଜଣାପଡ଼େ ନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: A caregiver hears a neighbour dismiss their exhaustion as an easy task and replies with the question before explaining the work involved. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Dictionary supplies body-pain sense and saying; empathy reading is editorial, not a medical claim. Related to073/159 inward-experience themes, but not an exact variant of them.

entries.odia: ଲୁଣ ଖାଇବା ଯାହାର, ଗୁଣ ଗାଇ ତାହାର
entries.title: Whose salt, whose praise?
entries.literal_meaning: Eat someone’s salt; sing that person’s merits.
entries.explanation: Salt stands for livelihood received through service in the dictionary definition. The line links material dependence with praise of the provider. It may express loyalty, or make a sharp comment about praise shaped by dependence; the occasion decides the force. It does not establish that every employee’s praise is dishonest or that support requires silence.
entries.meaning_odia: ଏଠି ଲୁଣ ଖାଇବା କେବଳ ଖାଦ୍ୟର କଥା ନୁହେଁ; ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା କାହା ଅଧୀନରେ ଚାକିରି କରି ଜୀବିକା ଚଳାଇବା। ଯାହାଠାରୁ ଜୀବିକା ମିଳେ ତାହାର ପ୍ରଶଂସା କରିବା ସହ କଥାଟି ଯୋଡ଼େ। କେବେ ଏହା ଆନୁଗତ୍ୟର କଥା, କେବେ ନିର୍ଭରତା ପାଇଁ ହେଉଥିବା ପ୍ରଶଂସାକୁ ଟାହି। ସବୁ କର୍ମଚାରୀଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ମିଛ କିମ୍ବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ନେଲେ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିବାକୁ ହେବ ବୋଲି ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: The salt image connects livelihood with loyalty—or praise shaped by dependence.
entries.odia_summary: ଜୀବିକା ଓ ପ୍ରଶଂସାର ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଲୁଣର ଛବି ଧରେ।
entries.usage_example: After hearing an adviser praise every decision of the person who pays them, a listener quietly repeats the line. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Service meaning is sourced; two possible conversational tones are editorial. Companion refusal wording is recorded separately, not counted as another saying.

entries.odia: କହିଲେ କୁଳକୁଟୁମ୍ଭଙ୍କୁ ଲାଜ, ନ କହିଲେ କୁଳ ଭାସି ୟାଉଛି
entries.title: The cost of speaking, the cost of silence
entries.literal_meaning: If I speak, the family is ashamed; if I do not, the family is being swept away.
entries.explanation: Both choices carry a cost. Speaking exposes something embarrassing; remaining silent allows the damage to grow. The image of a family being swept away makes silence seem less safe than it first appears. The saying voices a dilemma, not a command to conceal wrongdoing for the sake of reputation.
entries.meaning_odia: କହିଲେ ପରିବାରର ଲାଜ, ନକହିଲେ ପରିବାରର କ୍ଷତି—ଦୁଇ ପଟେ ଚିନ୍ତା। ଚୁପ୍ ରହିଲେ ମାନ ରହିଯିବ ବୋଲି ଲାଗିପାରେ, ହେଲେ ଭିତରର ଅସୁବିଧା ବଢ଼ୁଥାଏ। କୁଳ ଭାସିଯିବାର ଛବି ସେହି ବିପଦକୁ ତୀବ୍ର କରେ। ଏହା ଦ୍ୱିଧାର କଥା; ପରିବାରର ନାମ ପାଇଁ ଭୁଲ ବା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଲୁଚାଇବାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Protecting a family’s reputation by silence may allow its troubles to deepen.
entries.odia_summary: ପରିବାରର ଲାଜ ବଞ୍ଚାଇବାକୁ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିଲେ କ୍ଷତି ବଢ଼ିପାରେ।
entries.usage_example: A family member discovers mounting unpaid bills and uses the saying while deciding how to begin an uncomfortable but necessary conversation. (Original imagined example, not collected testimony.)
entries.cultural_context: Source defines family and gives the complete dilemma; the bills example is new. No particular household, historical event or duty to hide harm is asserted.
